title: Why Brent Kochuba Is Buying the Tech Selloff Before Meta and Tesla Report
speaker: Brent Kochuba

macro_themes.view: Tech selloff looks like rotation (equal-weight S&P and Dow fine) and a correction rather than something more material.
Dips have been bought ferociously for 6 months; one headline (e.g. Meta/Tesla beats, merger rumours) could spark a sharp squeeze into year-end.

calls.reason: Vol coming down; vanna flows should ratchet market higher; QQQ can rally 1-2% quickly, played via 1-2 DTE call flies before Meta/Tesla.
calls.quote: I like shortdated call flies... I just want to be, you know, cognizant and positioned for for a short-term bounce.

calls.reason: S&P only ~2% off all-time high despite every reason to sell; downside has been bought back; watching correlation and VIX term structure for a change.
calls.quote: any downside movement has been bought back and bought back ferociously and so I think we just have to keep operating off of that assumption

notes: No explicit date; Meta/Tesla "Wednesday" upcoming and same show segment as Tim Knight (vBu8w7FWQ6U, Mon 2026-10-19), so likely 2026-10-19 (listing 10-20). Co-host said he got long tech names; not recorded (not the guest).
